notes:
## Better
- Flash assistant starts again when another car is connected, never carries a "flash even if up to date" target into a whole-car update, and stops when the vehicle order and the job are for two different cars.
- Exclude modules no longer remembers ticks for a car it cannot name.
- Register a new battery: only for petrol engine computers it knows, never sent blind when the battery cannot be read, and never while another E-Sys MAX job starts.
- Service reset: an item the engine or brake module cannot reset itself is reset in the instrument cluster.
- Message windows fit their text: no more big empty boxes.
- Coding history: version rows fit their column.
- Car reports and imported names files are safer with odd files from others.
